shortDescription: NetApp StorageGRID manage users within a tenancy.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the StorageGRID Admin Node REST API.

options.name: auth_token
options.description: The authorization token for the API request

options.name: disable
options.description: Disable the user from signing in. Does not apply to federated users.

options.name: full_name
options.description: Full Name of the user. Required for create operation

options.name: member_of
options.description: List of unique_groups that the user is a member of.

options.name: password
options.description: Set a password for a local user. Does not apply to federated users. Requires root privilege.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified user should exist or not.

options.name: unique_name
options.description: Unique Name for the user. Must begin with C(user/) or C(federated-user/). Required for create, modify or delete operation.

options.name: update_password
options.description: Choose when to update the password. When set to C(always), the password will always be updated. When set to C(on_create), the password will only be set upon a new user creation.
